title: Change of variables for the dilation η_{x,λ} on ℝ^P
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let F : ℝ^P → ℝ be an arbitrary function (no measurability or integrability assumption), x ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0, and let η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹(y − x) (Contract `dilation x λ`, y ↦ −λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹y, where ℝ^P = Euclid P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)). Then ∫ F(η_{x,λ}(y)) dy = λ^P · ∫ F(z) dz, both integrals being Bochner integrals over all of ℝ^P with respect to Lebesgue measure (volume), with Mathlib's convention that a non-integrable function has integral 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Euclid P → ℝ) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∫ y, F (dilation x lam y) = lam ^ P * ∫ z, F z
